description:
- New email reminder, the third channel in the Messaging section: tap Email to pick a contact's address (or use "Type a number or address instead"), and it shows as a tag you can tap to change or remove with its x. When a reminder fires, the task's notes (or its title) are emailed there with the task title as the subject, together with any WhatsApp or SMS contacts on the same task.
- Email is sent from your own mailbox over SMTP: set it up once in Settings > Special task settings > Email reminders (or from the "Set up" shortcut under the tag). Gmail needs an app password; the setup window explains the steps and checks the sign-in before saving. The password stays on the phone and is excluded from Android backups. There is also a "Send a test email to myself" button, and every send is traced in Settings > Diagnostics (tag Email).
- The email address is carried by cloud sync, desktop sync and backups, like the SMS and WhatsApp contacts.
- WhatsApp and email now share one short "Sending reminder" service.
